verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm selling legal services, not a software product, so reading its source code under an open license is a category error for this kind of offering. The Clerky partnership is a third-party platform, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm itself ships software or open-licensed code that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
